risk_summary: The disclosure is quantitatively detailed but highlights material uncertainty around GSE eligibility, evolving capital standards, regulatory changes, and reliance on remediation and reinsurance arrangements. MGIC was below required financial-strength ratings and had previously exceeded the 25-to-1 risk-to-capital threshold, although capital infusions and reinsurance improved reported metrics. The overall tone is cautious and risk-aware rather than crisis-like.
